_schema.generated: ISO timestamp of the daily refresh; the page shows it and flags >=2d stale
_schema.tickers: map of ticker id -> array of news items, any order (the page sorts newest-first and filters to the last 7 days)

item.date: YYYY-MM-DD, the day the news broke (the page joins this to own price data for the 1d move)
item.headline: one line, what happened
item.why: optional, one line on why it matters for this name
item.src: publication or filing the item came from - required for anything asserted as fact

META.headline: Meta opened paid developer access to Muse Spark 1.3; its AI chief called it the biggest jump yet on model performance and said it matches Anthropic and OpenAI offerings, and shares rose about 3.5%
META.why: Frontier-model parity claim plus paid API access is the clearest test yet of returns on Meta's AI capex

META.headline: WhatsApp launched bill payments in India across 22,722 billers on the Bharat Connect (BBPS) network, rolling out gradually on Android and iOS
META.why: Extends monetization of WhatsApp's largest user base beyond messaging into recurring payments

META.headline: Morgan Stanley said the $18B state settlement removes a legal overhang and could clear the way for new AI launches (MetaClaw, agentic ad tools, subscriptions, API/cloud), with a $775 price target
META.why: Sell-side reframing of the settlement from liability to catalyst, with an EPS uplift of more than $10 attributed to the pipeline

META.headline: Meta released Muse Voice Transcribe, its first real-time audio model, via the Meta Model API at $3 per 1,000 audio minutes
META.why: A priced, developer-facing model expands Meta's move from free open models toward direct AI revenue

NVDA.headline: NVIDIA disclosed a definitive agreement to acquire Hugging Face for approximately $11.9 billion in cash to stockholders plus an equity retention program of up to about $1.0 billion, with closing expected in the first half of 2027 subject to regulatory approvals
NVDA.why: Largest NVIDIA acquisition since Mellanox; extends the company from silicon into the open-model distribution layer, and the filing states the deal is conditioned on regulatory approvals
NVDA.src: NVIDIA Corporation Form 8-K (date of report Sept 2, 2026; filed Sept 3, 2026)

AAPL.headline: Apple was hit with a £2 billion ($2.7 billion) UK class action at London's Competition Appeal Tribunal, filed by ATT Collective Action Limited, alleging it applied stricter App Tracking Transparency rules to third-party developers than to its own advertising services
AAPL.why: Adds to UK legal exposure following the tribunal's ~£1.5 billion App Store commission ruling; the claim still requires certification

AAPL.headline: Morgan Stanley's Erik Woodring estimated the first foldable iPhone could contribute about $14 billion of December-quarter revenue, with 7-8 million units built in 2H26 and up to 20 million over the first product cycle
AAPL.why: Sizes the revenue contribution of a new product category ahead of the Sept 9 event; Woodring kept an Overweight rating and $360 target

AAPL.headline: John Ternus became Apple CEO, with Tim Cook moving to executive chairman, completing the succession announced in April 2026
AAPL.why: First leadership change in 15 years, days before the company's biggest product launch of the year

AAPL.headline: Apple disclosed Ternus's pay package: $3 million salary and a $55 million target annual equity award, 75% of which is performance RSUs vesting on Apple's total shareholder return relative to the S&P 500, plus a one-time prorated $2.5 million RSU grant
AAPL.why: Ties the majority of the new CEO's compensation to relative shareholder return

MSFT.headline: Stifel analyst Brad Reback raised his Microsoft price target to $530 from $450 while maintaining a Hold/Neutral rating, after meetings with management pointed to broader Microsoft 365 Copilot deployment, with weekly active engagement described as on par with Outlook and Teams.
MSFT.why: An 18% target raise held at Hold frames the debate as Copilot adoption improving while valuation caps upside.

MSFT.headline: Microsoft filed an 8-K restructuring reporting into two segments — Agents and Infra, and Devices and Consumer — from fiscal 2027, and will begin disclosing Azure revenue in dollars under a narrower definition excluding GitHub cloud, Security Copilot and healthcare cloud; restated Azure revenue was $
MSFT.why: First standalone dollar disclosure of Azure resets the segment model and the AI-revenue debate for every MSFT estimate.

MSFT.headline: BofA Securities analyst Tal Liani raised his Microsoft price target to $600 from $500, keeping a Buy rating, citing 4Q26 validation of the AI strategy with Azure growth going from 39% in 3Q26 to 43% in 4Q26 and guidance of 45% in 1Q27.
MSFT.why: A 20% target hike from a major bulge-bracket house anchors the bull case on Azure acceleration.

GOOGL.headline: Judge Leonie Brinkema rejected the DOJ's bid to force Google to divest its AdX ad exchange, imposing behavioral remedies instead, including real-time bid access for rival publisher ad servers
GOOGL.why: Removes the structural-breakup risk hanging over Google's open-web display ad business, leaving the ad tech stack intact under conduct rules
GOOGL.src: Al Jazeera / AdExchanger (E.D. Va. Case 1:23-cv-108, Doc. 1857)

GOOGL.headline: Google launched Gemini 3.8 Flash and a Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber security variant, its third Flash model in six weeks, across the Gemini app, AI Mode, Sheets, AI Studio and the Gemini API
GOOGL.why: Model cadence and a paid enterprise/government cybersecurity tier speak to Google's competitive position and monetization in AI

GOOGL.headline: Berkshire Hathaway CEO Greg Abel publicly explained the conglomerate's roughly $37 billion Alphabet stake on CNBC, calling Alphabet a significant player in AI
GOOGL.why: First detailed rationale from the holder of what is now one of Berkshire's largest US equity positions in Alphabet

AMZN.headline: Amazon's Zoox extended its commercial robotaxi service to Harry Reid International Airport in Las Vegas, with airport pickup and dropoff at both terminals starting September 5
AMZN.why: First robotaxi operator serving the airport, extending Zoox's paid-service footprint weeks after it began charging for rides

AMZN.headline: DOJ Antitrust Division expanded its beef-pricing investigation to eight grocery retailers including Amazon, requesting 2020-2026 records on beef purchasing, retail pricing, margins and price analyses
AMZN.why: Adds a second active federal antitrust exposure alongside the FTC case, targeting Amazon's grocery business

AMD.headline: AMD unveiled the Threadripper Halo Station at IFA 2026: a liquid-cooled workstation pairing the 96-core Threadripper PRO 9995WX with up to four Instinct MI350P accelerators (up to 576GB HBM3E), pitched as able to run trillion-parameter models locally
AMD.why: Pushes Instinct silicon into the on-prem AI workstation market and puts AMD in direct competition with Nvidia's DGX Station in a new revenue category

AMD.headline: At its IFA 2026 opening keynote, AMD's Jack Huynh introduced a second-generation Ryzen AI Halo developer platform with 192GB unified memory, said to run 125-billion-parameter models locally, with HP and Lenovo systems on the Ryzen AI Max 400 series due to reach customers in Q3 2026
AMD.why: Extends AMD's local/on-device AI franchise in client compute and sets the Q3 2026 OEM shipment timing for the Ryzen AI Max 400 series

AVGO.headline: Macquarie Equity Research upgraded Broadcom to Outperform from Neutral and raised its price target to $490 from $437, citing the Anthropic compute ramp and reduced Google insourcing risk
AVGO.why: A rating upgrade, not just a target change, from a firm modeling over $40B of Anthropic purchases in FY2028

AVGO.headline: Broadcom reported Q3 FY2026 revenue of $29.6B, up 86% y/y, with AI semiconductor revenue of $16.7B, up 221% y/y, and non-GAAP diluted EPS of $3.32; declared a $0.65 quarterly dividend payable Sept 30, 2026
AVGO.why: AI accelerators and networking are now the majority of revenue, resetting the earnings base for the company

AVGO.headline: Broadcom guided Q4 FY2026 revenue to approximately $34.8B, up 93% y/y, with AI revenue of $21.7B, up 236% y/y, and CEO Hock Tan told the earnings call AI revenue is expected to roughly double again in each of the next two years, to about $115B in FY2027 and $230B in FY2028
AVGO.why: The multi-year AI revenue framework is the primary driver of forward estimates and valuation
AVGO.src: Broadcom Q3 FY2026 earnings call / Broadcom press release

AVGO.headline: On the earnings call Hock Tan said Anthropic is on track to become Broadcom's largest XPU customer in 2027, and described a new long-term Google agreement covering multi-tens of billions of dollars of TPUs annually, with production shipments of Google's TPU v8i underway
AVGO.why: Names the specific customer commitments underpinning the FY2027-28 AI targets and addresses Google insourcing concerns

INTC.headline: Intel Foundry and ASML said High NA EUV is in high-volume manufacturing at Intel, with more than one million wafers processed to date, and that High NA layers on Intel 18A meet or exceed comparable NXE-patterned layers
INTC.why: Supports Intel's claim of a lithography lead ahead of the 14A ramp, the node its external foundry customer pipeline depends on
INTC.src: Intel Corporation press release (intc.com investor relations)

INTC.headline: Global Equities Research analyst Trip Chowdhry published a $200 price target on Intel, citing 16x year-over-year CPU demand growth and pointing to Dell's reported 122% year-over-year jump in traditional server revenue as validation
INTC.why: An outlier bull target roughly double consensus that was widely cited during Intel's ~7% weekly gain

INTC.headline: Mizuho analyst Vijay Rakesh cut his Intel price target to $92 from $109, keeping a Neutral/Hold rating, citing near-term multiple compression for agentic-AI names alongside foundry margin pressure and weaker PC demand
INTC.why: A top-ranked semis analyst cut his target below the then-current share price of about $91.67, against a sell-side consensus target near $116

TSM.headline: ASML and TSMC announced a joint industry initiative to move High NA EUV from 6-inch to 12-inch photomasks, targeting a mask pilot line in 2031 and advanced-node production on 12-inch High NA systems by 2033; TSMC said it intends to use High NA in high-volume manufacturing for advanced nodes starting
TSM.why: First firm public timeline for TSMC's High NA adoption, a key input to long-term leading-edge cost structure and its lead over competing foundries

TSM.headline: Cliff Hou said TSMC is building 25 fabs and advanced packaging facilities worldwide this year, 13 of them in Taiwan, a fivefold acceleration versus its historical 5-6 per year, and still cannot keep pace with AI demand
TSM.why: Demand exceeding a fivefold expansion supports pricing power and utilization, while the build-out scale raises execution and depreciation risk

TSM.headline: TSMC's estimate of its quarterly chipmaking-tool needs has nearly doubled since December, to about 1.9x the level it projected, Deputy Co-COO Cliff Hou said at Semicon Taiwan
TSM.why: Equipment procurement running ~90% above the December plan points to capex above the $60-64bn 2026 budget and to sustained AI-driven capacity build

ASML.headline: ASML and TSMC announced a joint industry initiative to move High NA EUV from 6-inch to 12-inch photomasks, targeting a mask pilot line by 2031 and production readiness by 2033; TSMC said it intends to use High NA in high-volume manufacturing for advanced nodes from 2030
ASML.why: First public TSMC timeline for adopting High NA, ASML's ~$400m-per-tool next-generation platform, and a roadmap commitment from its largest customer

ASML.headline: Samsung Electronics and ASML expanded their strategic collaboration, with Samsung planning to introduce High NA EUV into DRAM high-volume manufacturing by 2028 and joining the 12-inch photomask initiative
ASML.why: Extends High NA demand beyond logic into memory, a new end market for ASML's highest-priced systems
ASML.src: Samsung Global Newsroom / ASML press release

ASML.headline: Intel Foundry and ASML said High NA EUV is in high-volume production at Intel with more than one million wafers processed to date across certification, R&D and volume production on select layers of Core Ultra Series 3 (Panther Lake), with overlay, throughput and availability meeting Intel's expectat
ASML.why: Production-scale validation of High NA performance, the key gating factor for further customer orders
ASML.src: ASML/Intel Foundry press release (SPIE Photomask Technology + EUV Lithography conference)

MU.headline: Industry reports said Micron is adding roughly 60,000 wafers/month of HBM capacity to reach about 100,000 wafers/month by year-end, with 12-Hi HBM4 potentially half of output
MU.why: Would roughly double HBM output and narrow the capacity gap with SK hynix and Samsung in the highest-margin memory segment

MU.headline: Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick said the administration's Section 232 semiconductor tariffs will exempt US-based production and impose duties of up to 100% on chips made abroad, citing Micron's US investment
MU.why: Sets the tariff framework for imported memory and bears on the payoff from Micron's US fab build-out

MU.headline: The Federal Circuit affirmed PTAB decisions cancelling five Netlist memory patents that had been asserted against Micron
MU.why: Removes a set of patent claims from Netlist's long-running litigation against Micron
MU.src: Bloomberg Law; US Court of Appeals for the Federal Circuit opinions (Nos. 24-1707, 24-1859)

MU.headline: Micron's Taiwan unions, representing ~10,000 of its ~15,000 workers in Taoyuan and Taichung, threatened to strike unless the company overhauls its bonus system; Micron said this year's bonus payout will be its largest ever
MU.why: Taiwan is Micron's largest manufacturing base for DRAM and HBM, so a work stoppage there is a direct supply risk

9988.headline: Tmall launched an 'AI Space Station' marketplace selling AI subscriptions, token top-ups and specialised packages from Alibaba Cloud, Z.ai, MiniMax and DeepSeek; SCMP reports AI token and subscription transactions across Taobao and Tmall rose more than 160% within 48 hours of Z.ai opening its storef
9988.why: Opens a new AI monetisation channel that runs through the core commerce platform rather than the cloud sales motion

9988.headline: Alibaba released Qwen3.8-Max-0902, a post-training upgrade to its 2.4T-parameter flagship focused on coding and agent work, at unchanged pricing; TechNode reports its front-end Code Arena score rose 22 points to 1,691, first on that leaderboard
9988.why: Flagship model competitiveness underpins the Alibaba Cloud external revenue growth and AI commercialisation thesis that justifies the RMB380bn capex programme

0700.headline: Bilibili priced $700m zero-coupon convertible notes; Tencent subscribed for $200m of the notes while selling 26,374,900 Bilibili Class Z shares at HK$115.38 via placing, with Bilibili repurchasing a further 13,591,090 Class Z shares/ADSs held by Tencent at the same price
0700.why: Converts part of Tencent's Bilibili equity stake into debt and returns cash to Tencent, reshaping a sizeable investment-portfolio holding

0700.headline: Tencent-backed AI chipmaker Enflame priced its Shanghai STAR Market IPO at RMB142.18/share raising about RMB6.12bn, with the retail tranche 4,073 times subscribed and the online portion 6,109 times covered
0700.why: Tencent holds a roughly 20% stake in Enflame and is a major customer, so the listing marks the stake and its domestic AI-chip supply link

0700.headline: Tencent launched the WorkBuddy open platform (open.WorkBuddy.cn) at a Shenzhen event, opening its Skill/Expert/Connector agent capabilities to over 100 initial ecosystem partners, with nine co-branded smart hardware devices and 30+ industry applications
0700.why: Extends Tencent's AI office agent from an in-house product to a third-party platform, a step in monetising its Hunyuan-based AI stack
0700.src: Science and Technology Daily (科技日报)

3690.headline: Brazil's antitrust regulator CADE denied Keeta's appeal against rival 99's restaurant exclusivity contracts and instead ordered broader inquiries into competitive practices across the Brazilian delivery market, including Keeta's entry
3690.why: Keeta is Meituan's flagship overseas expansion and Brazil is its largest new market; a widened regulatory review follows iFood's predatory-pricing complaint and raises execution and cost risk for the international segment
